# Foundations

## Lists and metadata {#lists data-subsection="Layout"}

- First unordered item
  - Nested unordered item
    - Third-level unordered item
- Second unordered item

1. First ordered item
2. Second ordered item

::: {.block title="定义"}
Blocks must survive the Lua normalization pass.
:::

# Edge cases

## This intentionally long frame title verifies that a title wrapping across several lines remains fully visible and moves the body below its measured height without clipping {#long-title}

The body must begin below the complete frame title.

## Mathematics {#mathematics}

Inline math $\sqrt{x}$ and display math must use the same scalable renderer.

$$
\sqrt{n}\left(\bar X_n-\mu\right)
\xrightarrow{d} \mathcal{N}(0,\sigma^2).
$$
